sloka: उद्धूत इव वायुः खे महदभ्रबलं बलात् ।समीक्ष्याभिद्रुतं युद्धे प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः ।रथेनादित्यवर्णेन नीलमेवाभिदुद्रुवे ।। ६.५८.३५ ।।।।
transliteration: uddhūta iva vāyuḥ khe mahadabhrabalaṁ balāt ।samīkṣyābhidrutaṁ yuddhe prahasto vāhinīpatiḥ ।rathenādityavarṇena nīlamevābhidudruve ।। 6.58.35 ।।।।

translations.english: Prahastha, the commander of the army darted, just as the violent wind blows away mass of clouds, observing Nila coming towards him, in his chariot which was bright as the sun.
